title: Puthoff and Davis never shown AARO notes of their interviews

tellings.quote: I mean I think uh Hal Putoff and Eric Davis to this day have never been shown the notes from their meetings with Arrow.

plain: The physicists Hal Puthoff and Eric Davis met with AARO, the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into UFO reports, and have never been shown the notes from those meetings. Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer, tells Michels this from what he understands. It would mean the people interviewed cannot check what the office recorded of what they said.
